messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When I went in, my thigh slammed into the edge of the ice.

output.original_text: When I went in, my thigh slammed into the edge of the ice.
output.joy: When I went in, my thigh happily bumped against the edge of the ice!
output.sadness: When I went in, my thigh painfully slammed into the edge of the ice.
output.fear: When I went in, my thigh suddenly slammed into the edge of the ice, and I felt a rush of panic.
output.anger: When I went in, my thigh forcefully slammed into the edge of the ice, and I was so furious about it.
output.surprise: When I went in, my thigh unexpectedly slammed into the edge of the ice!
output.disgust: When I went in, my thigh crashed against the edge of the ice, and it was just so unpleasant.
